update_log: Baseline initialization of high-frequency trivia regarding India's Presidents and Prime Ministers for Polity Static GK.

notable_presidents_and_milestones.name: Dr. Rajendra Prasad
notable_presidents_and_milestones.key_fact: The first President and the only one to serve two full terms (1950–1962). Longest-serving President.

notable_presidents_and_milestones.name: Dr. Zakir Husain
notable_presidents_and_milestones.key_fact: First Muslim President. First President to die in office, and the one with the shortest tenure.

notable_presidents_and_milestones.name: V. V. Giri
notable_presidents_and_milestones.key_fact: Served as the first Acting President. He is also the only President elected as an independent candidate (not backed by the ruling party).

notable_presidents_and_milestones.name: Neelam Sanjiva Reddy
notable_presidents_and_milestones.key_fact: The only President to be elected unopposed (1977).

notable_presidents_and_milestones.name: K. R. Narayanan
notable_presidents_and_milestones.key_fact: The first Dalit President of India.

notable_presidents_and_milestones.name: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam
notable_presidents_and_milestones.key_fact: Known as the 'Missile Man of India'. The first scientist and the first bachelor to become President.

notable_presidents_and_milestones.name: Pratibha Patil
notable_presidents_and_milestones.key_fact: The first woman President of India.

notable_presidents_and_milestones.name: Droupadi Murmu
notable_presidents_and_milestones.key_fact: The first tribal (Santhal) President, the youngest President, and the first President born in independent India.

notable_prime_ministers_and_milestones.name: Jawaharlal Nehru
notable_prime_ministers_and_milestones.key_fact: The first and longest-serving Prime Minister (nearly 17 years). First PM to die in office.

notable_prime_ministers_and_milestones.name: Lal Bahadur Shastri
notable_prime_ministers_and_milestones.key_fact: Coined the slogan 'Jai Jawan Jai Kisan'. The only Indian PM to die abroad (Tashkent, Uzbekistan, in 1966).

notable_prime_ministers_and_milestones.name: Indira Gandhi
notable_prime_ministers_and_milestones.key_fact: First and only woman PM. First PM to be assassinated.

notable_prime_ministers_and_milestones.name: Morarji Desai
notable_prime_ministers_and_milestones.key_fact: First non-Congress PM. The oldest person to become PM (at 81). The only Indian PM to receive Pakistan's highest civilian award, Nishan-e-Pakistan. First PM to resign from office.

notable_prime_ministers_and_milestones.name: Charan Singh
notable_prime_ministers_and_milestones.key_fact: The only Prime Minister who never faced the Parliament during his tenure.

notable_prime_ministers_and_milestones.name: Rajiv Gandhi
notable_prime_ministers_and_milestones.key_fact: The youngest Prime Minister of India (took office at age 40).

notable_prime_ministers_and_milestones.name: P. V. Narasimha Rao
notable_prime_ministers_and_milestones.key_fact: The first Prime Minister from Southern India. Overseer of the 1991 LPG (Liberalization, Privatization, Globalization) economic reforms.

notable_prime_ministers_and_milestones.name: Atal Bihari Vajpayee
notable_prime_ministers_and_milestones.key_fact: Holds the record for the shortest tenure (13 days in 1996). Also the first non-Congress PM to complete a full 5-year term (1999–2004).

notable_prime_ministers_and_milestones.name: Dr. Manmohan Singh
notable_prime_ministers_and_milestones.key_fact: The first Sikh Prime Minister. He was the RBI Governor (1982-1985) and Finance Minister (1991-1996) before becoming PM.

notable_prime_ministers_and_milestones.name: Narendra Modi
notable_prime_ministers_and_milestones.key_fact: The first Prime Minister born in independent India (born in 1950).

acting_officials_trivia.name: Gulzarilal Nanda
acting_officials_trivia.key_fact: The only person to serve as Acting PM twice (first after Nehru's death, then after Shastri's death).

acting_officials_trivia.name: Justice Mohammad Hidayatullah
acting_officials_trivia.key_fact: The only Chief Justice of India to serve as the Acting President of India (when both the President and Vice-President offices were vacant in 1969).
